newsitem.title: USA: Italy's Generali, Banorte form fund pact.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Generali, Banorte form fund pact.

text.p: Italy's Generali and Mexico's Grupo Financiero Banorte said in a joint press release that they are forming a strategic partnership to develop private pension funds, annuities and bancassurance in the Mexican market.

The two companies said they believe the Mexican economy and the Mexican government's opening of the financial sector, as well as the privitisation of the pension fund system have made it an attractive market in which to offer new products.
The two companies said they continue to negotiate the final details of a formal joint venture agreement.
A press statement made available to Reuters was originally released in Trieste, Italy and Monteray, Mexico.
